Please describe the broken link and proposed correction in an issue first; contributions are limited to collaborators. See the [contribution guide](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md) and [AI policy](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/AI_POLICY.md) for the contribution process.

<sub>Automated first-response triage (rich-triage skill). A maintainer will review.</sub>
